# Animation runtime

`gsap.min.js` and `ScrollTrigger.min.js` are the unmodified distribution files from **GSAP 3.15.0**, downloaded from the [official npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/gsap/v/3.15.0).

Copyright and license headers remain in both files. GSAP is distributed under its [standard no-charge license](https://gsap.com/standard-license/), not the repository's software license. The site serves these pinned files locally and does not load third-party scripts at runtime.
